sentences.text: Jacques Webster , Jr. -LRB- born April 30 , 1992 -RRB- , better known by his stage name Travis Scott -LRB- formerly stylized as Travi $ Scott -RRB- , is an American rapper , singer , songwriter and record producer from Houston , Texas .
In 2012 , Scott signed a record deal with Epic Records .	Epic	Epic Records	Epic Records	Epic Records

In November of the same year , Scott signed a deal with Very GOOD Beats , as an in-house producer , after appearing on the label 's debut compilation album Cruel Summer -LRB- 2012 -RRB- .	Very GOOD Beats	Very GOOD Beats	Cruel Summer	Cruel Summer (GOOD Music album)
In April 2013 , it was announced he signed with T.I. 's Grand Hustle imprint .	Grand Hustle	Grand Hustle
He released his first full-length project , a mixtape titled Owl Pharaoh , in May 2013 .	Owl Pharaoh	Owl Pharaoh
He then released his second mixtape Days Before Rodeo in August 2014 .	Days Before Rodeo	Days Before Rodeo	Rodeo	Rodeo (Travis Scott album)
His debut album Rodeo , was released on September 4 , 2015 .	Rodeo	Rodeo (Travis Scott album)
His sophomore album , Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight , was released on September 2 , 2016 .	Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight	Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight
